title: Advanced SQL Patterns
description: Go beyond everyday SELECT — master set operations for combining result sets, advanced aggregation with ROLLUP and FILTER, and recursive CTEs for hierarchical and gap-filling queries.
outcomes: You'll combine result sets cleanly with UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT, produce multi-level subtotals with ROLLUP and GROUPING SETS, write conditional aggregates with FILTER(WHERE ...), and build recursive CTEs for hierarchy traversal and calendar spines.
